items.t: Said gambling is illegal in Utah and that calling a company a "prediction market" or its federal registration does not place it above the law.
items.q: “Gambling is illegal in Utah, whether you place the bet, run the game, or promote it. Calling it a ‘prediction market’ doesn’t change what it is, and being federally registered doesn’t put a company above the law,” Brown said in a statement.

items.t: Said a jury confirmed that Live Nation and Ticketmaster monopolized the market, and that the next phase is seeking remedies.
items.q: Today, a jury confirmed what we went to court over: Live Nation and Ticketmaster monopolized the market at fans’ expense,” said Attorney General Brown.

record.t: Sued Kalshi in Utah state court, alleging a pattern of unlawful conduct.
record.q: Kalshi is “the manager of a back-alley gambling den” in a state where gambling is illegal, Utah’s Attorney General Derek Brown alleged in state court Tuesday, saying the company has shown a “brazen pattern of unlawful conduct.”
